terms.comment: Our description: unguentum, an ointment (ointment), and sōlāris, of the sun (Ov., Plin., in Lewis & Short). No reference work has a word for sunscreen.

phrases.latin: Prius tē unguentō sōlārī unguam; deinde ad lītus.
phrases.english: First I’ll put sunscreen on you; then to the beach.

sources: Lewis & Short: unguentum · Lewis & Short: solaris
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
